retriever.name: Golden Retriever
retriever.description: Bouncing tennis balls. A dependable first defender; upgraded balls ricochet through the swarm.

dachshund.name: Dachshund
dachshund.description: Leaves stinky traps that slow and damage passing wildlife. Four active traps per dog.

bulldog.name: Bulldog
bulldog.description: A booming bark hits a crowd and pushes it back. Draws nearby enemy attacks away from other dogs.

malinois.name: Belgian Malinois
malinois.description: The Fur Missile. A tactical vest absorbs damage while lightning-fast tackles break enemy armor.
